name: Clara Bertine Ronning (Olson)
locations: Union Cemetery, Ottosen, Humboldt County, Iowa
sources: FamilySearch, Iowa County Marriages, 1838-1934 (Thomas Mikal Olson, 27, born Humboldt, and Clara Bertine Rouning, 24, born Brookings County, S.D., Graettinger, Palo Alto County, 31 Mar 1922; his parents Ole K. Nelson and Kristi Nilson Kallestad, hers Andrew O. Rouning and Sarah Wald; ark 1:1:XJKH-SL9)
Find a Grave, memorial 97722038 (Thomas Mikel Olson, 25 Jun 1894 – 8 Jun 1991, Union Cemetery, Ottosen, Humboldt County) and 98630699 (Clara B. Ronning Olson, 8 Feb 1898 – 22 Jun 1970)
FamilySearch, United States Census, 1950 (Emmetsburg, Palo Alto County, Iowa; Thomas M. Olsen, 55, born Iowa, with Clara B. and Carroll; ark 1:1:6F3K-RC8N)
notes: Wife of Thomas Mikkel Olson and mother of Thomas Orlando "Umpa" Olson and Carroll Olson; her birth surname is not recorded.

Born 8 Feb 1898 at Hendricks, Minnesota (Find a Grave; the 1922 marriage record says Brookings County, South Dakota, just across the line), daughter of Andrew O. Ronning and Sigrid "Sarah" Wold; married Thomas Mikel Olson at Graettinger on 31 Mar 1922; died 22 Jun 1970 at Emmetsburg. Her siblings were Jeanette (Monson), Aubrey and Orcella (Ellis), and half-siblings Olai and Ida (Digre).
